verdict.rationale: ROS 2 positions itself as covering everything "from drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms". Community users confirm a large body of existing nodes and drivers, and shared message packages that act as agreed-upon robotics datatypes. The docs add bundled message packages, topics meant for streaming sensor data, and a predefined sensor-data QoS profile. However, nothing names drivers or message types for cameras, lidars, IMUs or GPS specifically, so delivery for those four sensor classes is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented sensor message types for images, laser scans, IMU and GNSS; named ready-made drivers for each sensor class; hands-on reports of sensor bring-up.
